publicLaunchScope: Hosted web/PWA and the published mobile release must be evaluated against the same exact release SHA. Physical-device gates remain mandatory where specified.
currentEvidenceAuthority: launch_evidence and signed_in_smoke_checks records bound to the exact release SHA, plus protected workflow artifacts validated by the launch-honesty pipeline
legacyLedgerNote: Pre-Wave-6 pass/waiver text below is historical only. It does not certify the current release and cannot be promoted into current evidence without exact-SHA revalidation.

hosting.proofRequired: Protected Firebase production deployment evidence for the exact current release SHA.
hosting.historicalProof: A Firebase deploy was recorded for BIN GROUP hosting in June 2026, but that proof is not bound to the current Wave 6 release SHA.

functionsDeploy.proofRequired: Protected production Functions deployment evidence for the exact current release SHA.
functionsDeploy.historicalProof: A Functions deployment was recorded in June 2026, but that proof is not bound to the current Wave 6 release SHA.

firebaseAuth.proofRequired: Exact-SHA hosted production proof for admin, owner, tenant, technician, and broker login on live Firebase Auth.
firebaseAuth.historicalProof: Five-role login was previously reported, but the record predates the current exact-SHA evidence model.

firestoreRules.proofRequired: Current exact-SHA security-rules proof plus hosted production authority verification.
firestoreRules.historicalProof: Earlier emulator security-rules runs are retained as history only.

storageRules.proofRequired: Exact-SHA hosted upload/download/delete proof for tenant photos, technician before/after proof, contracts, invoices, and Admin evidence access.
storageRules.historicalProof: Earlier Storage verification is not current-release proof.

firebaseFunctionsLiveSmoke.proofRequired: Exact-SHA production callable/trigger proof for owner payment, ticket dispatch, SLA checks, HR sync, notifications, and Sovereign AI. Deployment alone is insufficient.
firebaseFunctionsLiveSmoke.historicalProof: Earlier callable/trigger smoke evidence is not current-release proof.

firebaseCloudMessaging.proofRequired: Real physical-device token registration, foreground/background delivery, and disabled-permission fallback on the exact release SHA.
firebaseCloudMessaging.historicalProof: Earlier PWA notification reports are retained as history only and cannot satisfy the current physical-device gate.

googleMaps.proofRequired: Real physical-device GPS permission, map render, technician check-in, arrival tracking, and location-denied fallback on the exact release SHA.
googleMaps.historicalProof: Earlier GPS/Maps reports are retained as history only.

aiVisionOrTriage.proofRequired: Signed-in exact-SHA hosted Sovereign AI call with server-side secrets, verified safe fallback behavior, and no client-exposed provider keys.
aiVisionOrTriage.historicalProof: Earlier AI smoke evidence predates the current exact-SHA release.

phase1Payments.proofRequired: Real owner Cash/Cheque activation on a physical device, Admin approval and rejection, receipt/evidence, audit trail, and dashboard unlock on the exact release SHA. Bank Transfer and Stripe/Card must remain disabled.
phase1Payments.retiredHistoricalEvidence: The former manual-bank-transfer launch proof is retired because Bank Transfer is not an approved Phase 1 method.

paymentGatewayOrManualBank.reason: Bank Transfer and Stripe/Card are disabled for Phase 1 and cannot satisfy a current launch gate.

whatsappBusiness.proofRequired: Optional only: approved sender/templates, opt-in, verified webhook/signature flow, and hosted delivery evidence before describing WhatsApp as live.
whatsappBusiness.historicalProof: A sandbox webhook was previously reported; sandbox configuration is not production-live provider proof.

smsVoiceFallback.proofRequired: Optional only: carrier/provider approval, cost controls, delivery evidence, and emergency fallback test before describing SMS/voice as live.
smsVoiceFallback.historicalProof: Earlier fallback integration reports are not current production delivery evidence.

uaeDataResidencyPosition.proofRequired: Current data categories, subprocessors, hosting region, retention policy, and owner/tenant privacy wording reviewed for the exact release architecture.
uaeDataResidencyPosition.historicalProof: Earlier compliance documentation remains background material but is not current-release approval.

firebaseBillingPlan.proofRequired: Confirm the production Firebase project billing plan supports every Phase 1 backend provider actually enabled. Stripe credentials are not a Phase 1 requirement because Stripe/Card is disabled.

historicalWaiver.riskNote: Historical pilot waiver only; it cannot satisfy hard public launch.

appCheckEnforcement.proofRequired: Exact-SHA hosted proof of verified App Check traffic and enforcement on protected Firebase/callable operations.

historicalWaiver.riskNote: Historical pilot waiver only; it cannot satisfy hard public launch.

androidPwaSmoke.proofRequired: Real Android device test across all five dashboards on the exact release SHA.
androidPwaSmoke.historicalProof: Earlier Android PWA testing is not current-release proof.

iosPwaSmoke.proofRequired: Real iPhone/Safari test across all five dashboards on the exact release SHA.
iosPwaSmoke.historicalProof: Earlier iOS testing is not current-release proof.

technicianGpsTracking.proofRequired: Real technician GPS check-in, tracking, denied-location fallback and mission integrity on the exact release SHA.
technicianGpsTracking.historicalProof: Earlier GPS tracking evidence is not current-release proof.

pushNotifications.proofRequired: Real push delivery and denied-permission fallback on physical devices for the exact release SHA.
pushNotifications.historicalProof: Mock service-worker notification tests do not satisfy the current physical-device gate.

pdfMobileDownload.proofRequired: Arabic/English contract, invoice, lease, and report PDF download/open test on physical devices for the exact release SHA.
pdfMobileDownload.historicalProof: Earlier PDF checks are not current-release proof.

arabicRtlAllCoreScreens.proofRequired: Arabic RTL sweep for all five roles, modals, toasts, empty states, uploads, and PDFs on physical devices for the exact release SHA.
arabicRtlAllCoreScreens.historicalProof: Earlier RTL checks are not current-release proof.

everyButtonWritesFirestoreOrStorage.proofRequired: Button-by-button exact-SHA audit proving each action writes, reads, navigates, or fails safely on the real release surfaces.
everyButtonWritesFirestoreOrStorage.historicalProof: Earlier click-stream claims are not current-release proof.

logoutAllDashboards.proofRequired: Owner, tenant, technician, broker, and admin logout tests on desktop/mobile release surfaces for the exact SHA.
logoutAllDashboards.historicalProof: Earlier logout testing is not current-release proof.

androidReleaseAab.proofRequired: If Android Play publication is in scope, bind the signed AAB and physical Google Play install/runtime evidence to the exact release SHA.

historicalWaiver.riskNote: Historical web/PWA-first scope decision; current release scope must be evaluated separately.
